primary.title: Bank holiday next week: SBI, HDFC, others closed on this day between June 14 and June 21; check here
primary.summary: Private and public sector banks in India will be closed for two days between 15 June and 21 June 2026 due to holidays specified by the RBI. Preparedness is essential for customers planning visits, though online banking services remain available during the closure.
